title: A Survey on Automatic Credibility Assessment Using Textual Credibility Signals in the Era of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing literature that applies traditional machine learning, recursive neural networks, multi-task ordinal regression, and LLM prompting to classify the political leaning, framing, and ideological bias of news articles and social media posts.
Reviewing benchmarking studies (such as the Media Bias Identification Benchmark) that evaluate transformer models (e.g., ELECTRA) on their ability to detect racial bias in media texts.
Reviewing benchmarking studies (such as the MBIB collection) that assess the performance of language models in detecting gender bias within media content.
Reviewing datasets and benchmarking studies that test transformer models (e.g., ConvBERT) on identifying cognitive bias as a credibility signal in text.
